Write simulated genotypes as a VCF file

Source: R/genotypes.R
write_vcf.Rd

Writes a simulate_genotypes() object as VCF 4.2: one contig per simulated PvP01 chromosome, with the run's lengths; each locus at its 1-based position within its chromosome (so in "core" mode, a position on the shortened chromosome), its id in ID, and the ALT frequency it was painted with as PLAF in INFO, rather than AF, which tools read as the frequency among the samples. Records are sorted by chromosome and position. Clone samples are written haploid (0, 1, .) and host samples unphased diploid, as VCFs called from mixed Plasmodium infections are: 0/0, 1/1, 0/1 for both alleles present, ./.. The model has no sequence, so without ref and alt columns in the loci REF and ALT are the placeholders A and C, and the header says so.

Usage

write_vcf(x, file, calls = c("observed", "true"), chrom_names = NULL)

Arguments

x

a vivax_genotypes object, from simulate_genotypes().

file

the path to write; a name ending in .gz is gzip-compressed (for tabix, write a plain file and compress it with bgzip).

calls

"observed" (the calls with error and missingness) or "true".

chrom_names

NULL, or the 14 contig names by PvP01 number; by default PvP01_01_v2 to PvP01_14_v2, and as.character(1:14) gives numbered contigs.

Value

file, invisibly.

See also

simulate_genotypes()

Examples

run <- example_run()
loci <- data.frame(chrom = 1:14, pos = 1e5, plaf = 0.3)
g <- simulate_genotypes(run, classify_cases(run)$pedigree_id[1:10], loci, seed = 1)
f <- write_vcf(g, tempfile(fileext = ".vcf"))
readLines(f, n = 12)
#>  [1] "##fileformat=VCFv4.2"                                                        
#>  [2] "##source=malariafwd 0.1.0 simulate_genotypes()"                              
#>  [3] "##malariafwd_run=/tmp/RtmpjMBTAb/malariafwd-example-run-60b2e786"            
#>  [4] "##malariafwd_samples=clone"                                                  
#>  [5] "##malariafwd_calls=observed (error=0, missing=0)"                            
#>  [6] "##malariafwd_seed=1"                                                         
#>  [7] "##malariafwd_alleles=REF and ALT are placeholders: the model has no sequence"
#>  [8] "##contig=<ID=PvP01_01_v2,length=1021664>"                                    
#>  [9] "##contig=<ID=PvP01_02_v2,length=956327>"                                     
#> [10] "##contig=<ID=PvP01_03_v2,length=896704>"                                     
#> [11] "##contig=<ID=PvP01_04_v2,length=1012024>"                                    
#> [12] "##contig=<ID=PvP01_05_v2,length=1524814>"
